key_principles: No Startup Gradients: Replace with deep textures and subtle glows
Content is King: Photos must look expensive
Typography as Art: High contrast serif headings vs clean sans body
No Emojis: Use monochrome Lucide icons only

headings.usage: Hero titles, Section headers, Feature names

buttons.primary: bg-white text-black hover:bg-gray-200 rounded-sm font-medium px-8 py-3
buttons.secondary: border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/5 rounded-sm px-8 py-3
buttons.ghost: text-white/60 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5 rounded-sm px-4 py-2

inputs.default: bg-transparent border-b border-white/20 focus:border-white outline-none rounded-none px-0 py-4 placeholder:text-white/20 text-lg transition-colors

cards.default: bg-[#121212] border border-white/5 p-8 hover:border-white/10 transition-colors

hero.alt: Editorial fashion portrait in black lace

instructions_to_main_agent.step_1: Update tailwind.config.js to enforce dark mode and add new colors/fonts.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_2: Update globals.css to set root variables to dark theme values (override light defaults). Add noise texture class.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3: Refactor app/page.js (Landing Page) to remove gradients/blobs and implement the 'Editorial' layout using the new assets.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4: Update Shadcn components in components/ui to match the 'sharp' and 'minimal' aesthetic (remove heavy roundness).
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES: Ensure high contrast for text (APCA standard).
All containers with borders must have internal padding.
